_doc: Every generated sound. kind: chip = 8-bit (UI/orders/serve/results), real = recorded-style SFX, music = 8-bit loop, ambience = real loop. takes: prompt + seeds (+ optional seconds) per listening round; 'pick' is the approved candidate (a seed, 'synth_*' for code-synthesised chiptune, or 'reuse' for another approved sound). The model fills the requested duration, so max_seconds caps one-shots and single keeps only the first event; cut_first_gap_after drops a stray trailing note. Fixed entries were settled in listening rounds.
